leads.name: Larry Connors %b Strategy (Bollinger Band)
leads.economic_rationale: Identifies persistent 3-day consecutive Bollinger Band %b (< 0.2) downside exhaustion within a primary 200-day uptrend, exploiting multi-day statistical rubber-band snapping back toward upper Bollinger %b.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Three consecutive closes near the lower 2-sigma Bollinger Band during a bull trend exhaust short-term liquidation supply; once selling abates, index inflows mean-revert price toward %b > 0.8.
leads.entry_rule: Compute Bollinger Bands (length=20, mult=2.0) and percentB = (close - lowerBand) / (upperBand - lowerBand). On D1 close, enter Long when close > SMA(close, 200) and percentB < 0.2 for 3 consecutive bars (percentB[2] < 0.2 and percentB[1] < 0.2 and percentB < 0.2).
leads.exit_rule: Close Long on daily close when percentB > 0.8.
leads.take_profit_rule: Dynamic Bollinger mean-reversion exit when percentB > 0.8.
